title: Zigzag Persistence of Neural Responses to Time-Varying Stimuli
summary: We use topological data analysis to study neural population activity in the Sensorium 2023 dataset, which records responses from thousands of mouse visual cortex neurons to diverse video stimuli. For each video, we build frame-by-frame cubical complexes from neuronal activity and apply zigzag persistent homology to capture how topological structure evolves over time. These dynamics are summarized with persistence landscapes, providing a compact vectorized representation of temporal features.
